title: Micron CEO pushes back on memory bear case. 3 key takeaways from Cramer's big interview
summary: Micron's CEO countered bearish memory chip market predictions in an interview with Jim Cramer, with analyst insights suggesting confidence in the company's outlook. The discussion provided key takeaways that strengthened conviction in Micron as an investment.
content: Jim Cramer's extended interview with the CEO made us more confident in our newest stock position.

zh.title: 美光首席执行官反驳存储芯片熊市观点 克莱默专访的3个关键要点
zh.summary: 美光首席执行官在接受吉姆·克莱默采访时反驳了对存储芯片市场的悲观预测,分析师的见解表明对公司前景充满信心。这次讨论提供了加强投资者对美光投资信心的关键要点。

title: Stock futures are little changed after a steep sell-off sparked by a move back higher in Treasury yields: Live updates
summary: Stock futures remained flat following a significant market sell-off triggered by rising Treasury yields, with the Dow falling 700 points in its worst session since late July. The persistent yield pressure indicated continued uncertainty in equity markets.
content: The Dow ended Thursday's session down 700 points, marking its worst day since July 29.

zh.title: 股指期货在美债收益率上升引发大幅抛售后基本持平:实时更新
zh.summary: 股指期货在美债收益率上升引发的大幅市场抛售后保持基本平稳,道琼斯指数下跌700点,创下自7月底以来最差表现。持续的收益率压力表明股市仍存在不确定性。

title: CFTC’s Innovation Advisory Committee meeting addresses emerging prediction market risks
summary: The CFTC convened its Innovation Advisory Committee to examine risks in prediction markets, with regulators proposing stricter consumer protections. The discussion highlighted growing concerns about unregulated prediction market growth and investor vulnerability.
content: The CFTC's first Innovation Advisory Committee meeting discussed risks of mention markets, with members advocating for tighter consumer protection.

zh.title: 美国商品期货交易委员会创新顾问委员会会议讨论新兴预测市场风险
zh.summary: 美国商品期货交易委员会召集创新顾问委员会审查预测市场风险,监管机构提出更严格的消费者保护措施。讨论凸显了对不受监管的预测市场增长和投资者风险的日益关注。

title: Japan headline inflation rate hits highest this year as energy prices bite
summary: Japan's headline inflation reached its highest level in 2026 as surging energy prices pushed consumer costs higher, though core inflation came in at 1.8% as expected. The data reflects global commodity price pressures affecting Japan's economy.
content: Core inflation — which strips out prices of fresh food but includes energy — was in line with expectations, coming in at 1.8%.

zh.title: 日本标题通胀率因能源价格上升而创今年新高
zh.summary: 随着能源价格飙升推高消费者成本，日本2026年标题通胀率达到最高水平，尽管核心通胀率如预期为1.8%。这一数据反映了全球商品价格压力对日本经济的影响。

title: Japan's historic yen intervention has ‘turbo-charged’ the carry trade
summary: Japan's central bank intervention to strengthen the yen inadvertently boosted conditions for the carry trade, where investors borrow cheap yen to invest in higher-yielding assets elsewhere. The policy move created favorable arbitrage opportunities that may intensify capital outflows from Japan.
content: Japan's historic effort to prop up the yen may have had an unintended consequence: giving investors a better opportunity to put the carry trade back on.

zh.title: 日本历史性日元干预"加速推动"套利交易
zh.summary: 日本央行加强日元的干预措施无意中促进了套利交易的有利条件，投资者借入廉价日元投资其他高收益资产。这一政策举措创造了有利的套利机会，可能会加剧日本的资本外流。
